description: This file defines a React component 'Lightbox' for displaying images with zoom, rotate, and navigation features, including UI controls and event handling.

classes.name: Lightbox
classes.description: A React component for viewing images in a modal with zoom, rotate, and navigation controls.

methods.name: getXY
methods.description: Calculates the x and y coordinates from mouse or touch events.

methods.name: createTransform
methods.description: Generates CSS transform string based on position, zoom, and rotation.

methods.name: getCurrentImage
methods.description: Returns the current image URL based on component state.

methods.name: resetZoom
methods.description: Resets zoom and position to default.

methods.name: navigateImage
methods.description: Navigates to next or previous image.

methods.name: applyZoom
methods.description: Applies zoom in, out, or reset.

methods.name: shouldShowReset
methods.description: Determines if reset button should be shown.

methods.name: canvasClick
methods.description: Handles click on the image canvas.

methods.name: keyboardNavigation
methods.description: Handles keyboard events for navigation and controls.
